Inspire Arena on Yeongjong Island takes on a new name, 'NAVER Arena,' starting in December.

The K-pop venue opened in December 2023 with the Melon Music Awards and has since hosted SBS Gayo Daejeon. With NAVER signing a three-year naming rights deal with INSPIRE Entertainment Resort, its official name becomes 'NAVER Arena at INSPIRE.'

The two companies say they plan to introduce entry using Naver Pay's face-recognition service 'FaceSign' and NFTs, along with augmented reality wayfinding. No start date has been set. The first event under the new name is the women's tennis tournament 'NAVER x Hyundai Card THE SIX,' Dec 25–27.

仁川・永宗島（ヨンジョンド）のインスパイアアリーナが、12月から「NAVERアリーナ」という新しい名前になります。

2023年12月に「MelOn Music Awards」でオープンし、その後「SBS歌謡大典」も開かれたK-POP公演会場ですが、NAVER（ネイバー）がインスパイア・リゾートと3年間の命名権契約を結んだことで、正式名称が「NAVERアリーナ・アット・インスパイア」に変わります。

両社は、Naver Payの顔認証サービス「FaceSign（フェイスサイン）」やNFTを活用した入場、AR（拡張現実）による道案内を進めると発表しました。実施時期はまだ決まっていません。新しい名前で開かれる最初のイベントは、12月25日〜27日の女子テニス大会「NAVER×現代カード THE SIX」です。

[캡션]
From November 1, consumption tax on goods bought in Japan is refunded at the airport you depart from, not at the store.

Until now, showing a passport at the register meant the tax was taken off on the spot. Under the new refund system announced by the Japan Tourism Agency, shoppers pay the full price including tax, then get that amount back after a customs check when leaving the country. What counts is the purchase date, not the departure date, so anything bought by October 31 stays under the current system.

What changes is the order of steps at the airport. Before checking bags, travelers scan their passport at a tax-free procedure kiosk, and if asked for verification, they must show the goods they bought. Once bags are checked, the procedure can no longer be completed. Food and cosmetics consumed or used in Japan are not refunded, and the special sealed packaging for consumables is discontinued.

Effective: Purchases from Sun, Nov 1
Eligibility: JPY 5,000 or more per store per day (excluding tax)
Deadline: Depart within 90 days of purchase and complete the customs check
Info: Japan Tourism Agency tax-free special page · Japan National Tourism Organization (JNTO)

11月1日から、日本で購入した品物の消費税は、店頭ではなく出国する空港で払い戻されます。

これまではレジでパスポートを見せれば、その場で税額が差し引かれていましたが、観光庁が案内する新しい「リファンド方式」では、税込みで購入したうえで、出国時に税関の確認を経てその分が還付されます。基準は出国日ではなく購入日のため、10月31日までに購入した品物はこれまでの方式のままです。

変わるのは空港での手順です。荷物を預ける前に免税手続き用の端末でパスポートを読み取り、確認を求められた場合は購入品を提示する必要があります。荷物を先に預けてしまうと手続きができません。日本国内で飲食・使用した食品や化粧品は還付の対象外となり、消耗品の特殊包装は廃止されます。

施行：11月1日（日）購入分から
対象：同一店舗で1日5,000円以上（税抜）
期限：購入日から90日以内に出国し、税関確認を受けること
案内：観光庁 免税特設ページ・日本政府観光局（JNTO）

구글 제미나이와 웹예능 〈전과자〉가 성수동에 사흘짜리 가상 캠퍼스를 엽니다.

'스낵이 제미나이 캠퍼스'는 〈전과자〉 진행자 카이가 제안한 오프라인 캠퍼스 아이디어를 공간으로 옮긴 팝업인데요, 모바일 학생증을 발급받아 경영학·항공우주공학 같은 전공 부스와 동아리 부스를 돌며 미션을 푸는 방식입니다. 미션은 딥 리서치·캔버스 같은 제미나이 기능으로 풀게 됩니다.

Google Gemini and the web variety show 'Jeongwaja' are opening a three-day virtual campus in Seongsu-dong, Seoul.

The pop-up, 'Snack-i Gemini Campus', brings to life an offline campus idea proposed by the show's host, Kai. Visitors get a mobile student ID and make their way through booths for majors such as business administration and aerospace engineering, plus club booths, completing missions along the way. The missions are solved with Gemini features like Deep Research and Canvas.

There is also limited-edition merchandise featuring 'Ttokbu', a character that combines the two IPs. Google says pop-up sales will be donated in both partners' names to help low-income university students pay tuition. The pop-up is aimed mainly at university and graduate students, but anyone can visit without signing up.

Dates: Oct 30 (Fri) – Nov 1 (Sun)
Location: Hanseo Building, Seongsu-dong, Seongdong-gu, Seoul
Admission: Walk-in, no advance registration
Talks: Oct 30 producer Ko Dong-wan · Oct 31 Geekble's Sudragon · Nov 1 Oppadu Excel (register in advance via the Team Gemini KakaoTalk channel)
